title: Bird Is the Word
blurb: The Trashmen recorded Surfin' Bird in 1963, and Family Guy resurrected it in 2008 by giving Peter Griffin an obsession that eventually drove his entire family to violence. The repetition is not a side effect, it is the design: the song was built to be maddening and it succeeds completely, which is precisely why the episode works. Play it once for the nostalgia and then keep playing it until everybody in the room has been fully informed about the bird. Everybody has heard. Everybody has definitely heard.
origin: From Family Guy's Surfin' Bird episode.
